limitations: No SDK imports, decoding, builds, installations or remote mutations were performed by this review.
All 28 export leaf files exist in each package; only public Node ESM/CJS scanner/generator entries were exercised in the retained smoke evidence.
Eight smoke records are 24 repeated clean-case executions, not 24 independent test images or a broader accuracy metric.
Smoke interception fingerprints byte input to WebAssembly.instantiate; it is not a generic monitor for every WebAssembly API or network transport.
History and a retrospective tool-response observation document the first Node18 pre-import path error; original redirected stderr is explicitly not retained.
Source maps are retained build evidence, not proof against arbitrary runtime caller-supplied binaries; default CDN and capability identity remain explicitly unresolved.
